name: Hardware-Accelerated Volume Rendering via 3D Texturing
definition: A volume rendering method that leverages 3D texturing hardware (specifically Silicon Graphics RealityEngine) to perform reconstruction and resampling. Volume data is defined as a 3D texture. Polygons are embedded in the texture, and the hardware resamples the volume along these polygons. The resampled data is transformed into color and opacity values and composited into the frame buffer.
